artworks.title: The Descent of Christ into Limbo
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and distorted shapes, creating a complex and abstract composition. In the center, a circular form surrounds a figure. Around this, strange creatures and forms with familiar elements create an otherworldly landscape. The lower left features a large fish-like object and a massive gaping mouth consuming figures. At the top, curved structures and organic lines connect to surreal imagery. The scene combines elements resembling creatures and objects in an abstract way.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with multiple individuals. In the foreground, a person is seated near a fireplace. Surrounding individuals are gathered around a bed, observing or engaging with a figure lying down. The central figure in the bed has long hair, a beard, and a glowing halo-like circle around the head. The people around the bed appear to be interacting or praying. The setting includes historical clothing, goblets, pitchers, bowls, a cross-like symbol, and various ornamental objects. The background features a fireplace, a chair, books, and a figure possibly carved above the mantel in an interior room with wooden beams on the ceiling, curtains around the bed, and a separator.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Magician
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: This print is filled with fantastical creatures and distorted human figures that seem to tumble down into the scene from above. Some of these creatures have recognizable elements like faces, animal features, or clothing items, while others are contorted and unrecognizable. They seem to be causing chaos, some brandishing weapons or instruments and others doing somersaults or walking on their hands. On the right, several people stand together under an arched wall, looking in on the scene. At the front is a person with a halo, holding a long staff and lifting one hand up. On the left, a person sits among the creatures behind a table with small balls and cups stacked on it. In the bottom left corner, the body of a person is on a table. At the end of the table is a long sword and a decapitated head on a plate. There is a line of text at the bottom of the print.

artworks.title: The Rich Man Playing Violin on a Jaw Bone
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 17.8 cm (7 in.)
sheet: 18 × 17.8 cm (7 1/16 × 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a medieval setting. He is crouching on a cobblestone street, holding a saw. He is wearing a robe with fur trim, a tunic, and a wide-brimmed hat. A castle wall with towers is in the background, along with figures in a boat and a caged enclosure.

artworks.title: One Begs in Vain at the Door of the Deaf
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (diameter): 17.8 cm (7 in.) 
sheet: 17.8 × 17.8 cm (7 × 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a long robe standing in front of a door, with a hood covering their head. They are in front of a brick wall with a wooden door and a metal knocker. The scene is framed, with text inscribed along the edge. In the background, another figure is standing in a courtyard with brick buildings and a tree.

artworks.title: Epileptics Walking to the Left
artworks.artist: Hendrik Hondius I, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: A drawing of a group of people in a landscape setting. The individuals are closely grouped together, with their arms linked or intertwined. They are wearing long garments. In the background, there is a rural landscape with a bridge, trees, and a river, and additional figures crossing the bridge. The scene is highly detailed, emphasizing the textures of the clothing and natural elements.

artworks.title: Shrove Tuesday
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting several people in medieval attire gathered in a room with various objects. The scene shows detailed figures and items in fine lines and shading. The room contains hanging pots, a basket, fabric, and gourds. The characters are engaged in different activities, such as holding utensils and interacting with each other. Each character wears distinct clothing. A small dog is present on the floor. A central fireplace provides warmth and a gathering point. There is an inset image of a person playing a musical instrument. The drawing style is characterized by cross-hatching and exaggerated expressions.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher with the Christ Child
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century, after Master J. Kock
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, mounted on heavier laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within plate): 23 × 31.2 cm (9 1/16 × 12 5/16 in.)
mount: 25.9 × 34.2 cm (10 3/16 × 13 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hope and Julian Edison
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a scene with an elevated perspective of a landscape. A twisted tree supports a wooden hut with a figure holding a lantern. A river or sea shows two figures struggling against the current. Rugged cliffs with ancient structures are visible in the background. The sky is filled with detailed clouds. The color palette is grayscale.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Philip Neri in Adoration, an Angel, and Putti
artworks.artist: Giacinto Gimignani
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white, on laid paper; incised and the verso blackened for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical drawing with multiple figures. A man and a woman with halos are at the center, along with a child. The woman is seated on a cloud, positioning the child, with her face in profile. The man is seated next to her, wearing a robe. The child is standing on the cloud. To the right, a kneeling figure is visible, wearing ornate robes. Surrounding them are cherubs and angels with wings. One angel is flying above, while others are seated or reclining on the clouds. Below, two cherubs hold symbolic items; one holds a bouquet, and the other holds an open book. Clouds fill the background of this celestial scene.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Philip Neri in Adoration, an Angel, and Putti
artworks.artist: Giacinto Gimignani
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 34.1 × 25.2 cm (13 7/16 × 9 15/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical artwork with various figures. In the foreground, a seated woman is reaching towards a small child standing before her, while a kneeling man is beside them. Surrounding them are winged cherubs floating on clouds. In the background, faint outlines of architectural elements are visible.

artworks.title: Frances Clayton
artworks.artist: Samuel Masury
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing with one hand on the back of a chair. They have short, brushed back hair and a serious expression. The person wears a full-length gown with long sleeves, a high collar, and a fitted waist. They also wear a bowtie or cravat. The chair is richly decorated with a leather back and seat and ornate wooden details. The background is a plain, light color, emphasizing the person and their outfit.

artworks.title: Frances Clayton
artworks.artist: Samuel Masury
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a formal pose. They are slightly turned to the side, with their left hand resting on a chair and their right hand on a sword. The individual has a stern expression and defined facial features, with dark, neatly-combed hair. They are wearing a dark wide-brimmed hat with a decorative emblem, a buttoned jacket, trousers, and polished, dark shoes. The background is simple, with a plain wall and hardwood floor contrasting with the ornate chair.

artworks.title: Sibyl Reading
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century, after Ugo da Carpi
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in two blocks, printed in black and brown, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an indoor setting with only part of their bodies visible. The person on the right is seated and facing left, slightly turned towards the person holding a torch. They have a profile view, revealing delicate facial features and tightly curled hair pulled back elegantly. They are wearing a long, voluminous dress with puffed sleeves. The seated individual holds an open book in one hand, partially obscured by the flame. The person to the left is a smaller figure, standing, holding a large, lit torch that provides illumination. This smaller figure has curly hair and wears a simple, long-sleeved garment. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background showcases crosshatched textures with a subtle design, and the letter 'R' is prominently visible on one side.

artworks.title: The Yorke Family
artworks.artist: Daniel Gardner
artworks.medium: gouache, pastel paste, and pastel with graphite and possibly black chalk on prepared paper mounted to canvas (on a wooden stretcher)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals in a classical portrait. The central figure is a woman standing beside a large urn. On her right, a young boy stands holding a hat. Beside him, a man stands holding a rifle. To the left of the woman, a young girl holds a flower basket, and a younger boy leans towards a dog. The background features a forest scene with autumnal foliage.

artworks.title: Underground Prisons, Known as "the Wells"
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a wooden bench inside a dimly lit, rustic wooden room. The man is sitting with one leg bent and the other stretched out, leaning slightly forward. His face appears tense with strong features like a furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, and a defined jawline, along with a thick beard and disheveled dark hair. He is wearing a loose shirt and worn-out pants, holding a skull. The man is barefoot. The room has coarse wood paneling, a large wooden door, a low wooden ceiling, and a bucket nearby.

artworks.title: The "Giardin Scuro," for Executions by Strangling
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction within a dimly lit prison cell. The scene features an individual restrained on a chair with shackles, positioned near a barred window. The room is constructed of large stone blocks. The restrained individual is depicted in a state of apparent distress or exhaustion, leaning back in the chair. Two other figures, dressed in long robes, one holding a sizable cross, appear to be approaching the restrained individual. Another figure in more common attire stands in a relaxed pose, observing the interaction. The composition of light and shadow creates a dramatic and tense atmosphere.

artworks.title: The "Well," for Violators of State Law
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in a prison cell. The cell is dimly lit, with a person lying on the ground, partially propped up on a bed of straw. Another figure crouches nearby, holding a long stick from which smoke rises. The interior is confined and dark, with stone walls and a wooden staircase visible in the background.

artworks.title: The "Ovens," for Those Who Wouldn't Admit Their Crimes
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man lying on his side on a stone bed, curled up with his head resting on his hands facing left. He has a somber expression, short dark hair, and is wearing a long shirt, loose-fitting pants, and dark shoes. The surrounding area is a dim, arched stone structure resembling a prison cell, with a wooden bucket and bricks in the background.

artworks.title: The Canal dei Marani, Where State Inquisitors Had Them Drowned
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene on the water with two gondolas. In the center, a man is shown from head to toe wearing a light-colored coat, breeches, and shoes, positioned in a standing posture with his hands restrained behind him by another man. This central figure has disheveled hair and a distressed facial expression. The man restraining him wears a turban or headwrap. Beside them, on the left gondola, a third person, seen in profile, is dressed in a uniform with a coat and a large tricorn hat, rowing the gondola with a paddle. On the right gondola, two other men are visible; one is clad in religious attire, an elder with a long beard, and holds a cross in an extended hand, while the other man, cloaked, is grasping a long oar. The background features a dark sky with scattered clouds and a zigzag streak resembling lightning or a comet. The water beneath the gondolas is depicted with movement.

artworks.title: The Last Underground Prison: He Fell Dead into His Brother's Arms
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men in an underground setting. They are standing close together, with one slightly leaning on the other. The lighting is dim, with a torch providing light. Both men have long curly hair and intense facial expressions. They are dressed in period clothing typical of the late 18th or early 19th century. The background includes a stone cell with a bed, a wooden bucket, and a document on the floor. There is some faint fresco or writing on the wall to the left.

artworks.title: The "Sotto Piombi," Where Death Sentences Were Read
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside a dimly lit room. There are three people standing on the left side of the room, two of them looking at a document held by another character. A fourth person is seated on a bed to the right, holding an object. A clerical figure is seated next to them. The room has wooden paneling with a simple table and a plate on the floor.

artworks.title: Court of the Former State Inquisitors
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of robed figures seated behind a large table in a formal setting. The table is illuminated by lamps, with two flames on it. The background has drapery, a doorway to the left, and a framed artwork above. The central focus is on a standing figure presenting documents to the seated figures. The setting suggests a judicial or inquisitorial environment. An inscription at the bottom provides historical context.

artworks.title: The North Front of Old Somerset House in the Strand
artworks.artist: William Moss and Francis Jukes
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a grand architectural facade, likely from the 18th or 19th century, featuring a central building flanked by symmetrical wings. The roofline of the building has tall chimneys, against a cloudy sky. The artwork is rendered in detailed ink wash or sepia tones. In the foreground, there is a cobbled street with a horse-drawn carriage and pedestrians. There is a wrought iron fence running parallel to the building. The color palette is predominantly beige and brown.

artworks.title: Il Carnevale di Roma (Carnival in Rome)
artworks.artist: Friedrich Nerly
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene during a festival or parade. The drawing depicts a busy street with a crowd of people engaged in various activities. Some are around a central figure on a raised platform, and flags and banners are visible. Some individuals are on horseback. Surrounding buildings are shown, adding depth to the scene.
